# `adt unlock`

Unlock SAP objects (release stale locks)

```bash
adt unlock [options] [objectNames...]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument           | Description                                                        | Default |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `[objectNames...]` | Object name(s) to unlock (e.g., ZAGE_TTYP_STRTAB ZAGE_TTYP_STRUCT) |         |

**Options**

| Option                   | Description                                                         | Default |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--lock-handle <handle>` | Specific lock handle (if known)                                     |         |
| `--type <type>`          | Object type (CLAS, INTF, TTYP, TABL, DOMA, DTEL, PROG, FUGR, DEVC)  |         |
| `--uri <uri>`            | Direct object URI (skips search)                                    |         |
| `--force`                | Recover only a lock handle persisted by this CLI (never sends LOCK) |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
